title: Arm launches Total Design for Physical AI and robotics framework
summary: Arm has launched 'Total Design for Physical AI' and a new robotics framework to establish common standards across automated systems in physical industries (mining, agriculture, manufacturing, transport), addressing engineering fragmentation while targeting a projected $200 billion annual compute market by the 2030s.
problem_solved: Addresses the engineering fragmentation problem across physical industries where lack of standardized frameworks hinders integration of automated systems.
why_valuable: Provides standardized infrastructure enabling faster development and deployment of physical AI across multiple trillion-dollar industries, unlocking significant market opportunity.
